Status: literature evidence and research proposal. No SaturateLLM GPU experiments have been run.

PagedAttention reduces KV-cache fragmentation and enables sharing. Sarathi uses chunked prefills with stall-free batching. SOLA uses serving state. DuetServe combines spatial sharing with look-ahead dispatch. Current vLLM supports CUDA graphs and FlashInfer already profiles and caches kernel tactics. Generic batching, graph use or kernel autotuning is not a novel claim.

Use open-loop arrivals with a fixed workload and report both offered and completed rates. Include queue time in TTFT. Fix output-length policy; count successful output tokens only. Drain requests or state censoring explicitly. Propose five paired runs with common seeds and report uncertainty, retaining raw traces. Record GPU SKU, driver/CUDA, engine commit, model revision, precision, power settings and full configuration. Separate heavy profiler runs from timing runs. No numerical SLO is claimed as universal; select it from the intended workload before selection.
